title: Character sprite not properly showing on map

posts.author: WasolykTheWizard
posts.body: Hello, um, I have a problem. I created a character sprite (using a 3x4 cell grid) that currently measures 501x1428 px. What’s happening is that when I tried to place it on the map, the character appeared, but it didn’t fit properly. It showed up as a square in one of the map sections. However, I only want the character to fit with that resolution. What should I do?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
ingame or in editor?
in the editor all sprites are cropped to a single tile, because you need to be able to see the surrounding tiles to edit them.
only in game the full sprite is used, centered bottom on the event or player.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just as a piece of starting advice - you might want to spend some more time doing tutorials before spending it on stuff like making and importing art into your game.
Running a playtest is a very basic function of the editor. I'd suggest you complete the tutorial built into the editor's Help menu; a few additional tutorials on YouTube focusing on events is probably a good idea.
And just some basic stuff for
any
new piece of software you start using - do a visual scan, you should know what all of the buttons on the menu bar do.
Good luck!
